svg.title: Cross-archive links
svg.desc: Graph of five archives (Lazar, Chernobrov, Dubna, PURSUE R01 and R02, Gershtein) and five themes: element 115 and moscovium, time and space-time, Soviet aerospace lineage, US federal disclosure lineage, plasma phenomena in the US, UK and USSR. Solid thick edges link items inside one archive; labelled dashed edges link archive items to themes and to items of other archives. The links are the synthesis page's own thematic readings.
svg.text: Five archives and five themes of the synthesis
the previous PNG render stays in the repository.
Links are thematic or institutional readings of the synthesis page,
not proofs of a common source.
